description: File an invoice that didn't come through e-Factura (a scan, a PDF, a photo): read it, extract the accounting facts (parties' tax ids, net, VAT by rate), file it with the same fields as an e-Factura invoice and ask a person when it doesn't add up. Set documents.intake_workflow to invoice_intake for a client whose paper invoices arrive in chat.

key.description: The file's key in the bucket.

caption.description: Any note sent with the file.

read.system: You read Romanian invoices for an accountant. Copy the facts exactly as printed; don't compute or guess. Leave a field empty when it isn't on the page. Tax ids (CUI/CIF) with their RO prefix if printed. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Amounts as printed numbers.

kind.description: invoice, or credit_note for a storno / credit note.

vat_breakdown.description: One object per VAT rate printed: {rate, taxable, vat, category}; category AE for taxare inversă, Z for 0%, else S.

review.message: This invoice doesn't add up as read. Correct the facts (or reject it).
